title: Mirador + U1-U4 lexical final closeout
source: Nos vemos hoy 1 (A1), Units 1-3 + Mirador 4; final closeout after the v0.4.2 lexical catch-up. This pass corrects the Mirador source audit, adds remaining high-value U2 professions/contact symbols, U3 description contrasts, the U4 hacer/tener/tomar/llevar collocation set, and a small set of classroom-dialogue lexical gaps. Selection remains frequency-, dependency-, and travel/daily-use driven rather than exhaustive.
